== Update, December 12, 2025 ==

How often have you seen a press release from a company where they say they are ''thrilled'' to announce something?

Well I am ''genuinely thrilled'' to announce that we are now officially verified on [[wikipedia:Steam Deck|Steam Deck]].

To those of you noting the coincidental timing between our announcement supporting Steam Deck and then Valve announcing Steam Machine and a new Steam Controller - guess what? ''It really was a coincidence.'' And I am ''thrilled'' about these new platforms coming next year and happy in our expectation to be compatible with those as well.

Check it out! [https://store.steampowered.com/verified/29720/Guild_Wars_Reforged Guild Wars Reforged on Steam Deck].

==Guild Wars Wiki notes==
This announcement was made by [[Stephen Clarke-Willson|Dr. Stephen Clarke-Willson]].
